title: Circle Line Sightseeing
specs: Pass over 100 NYC landmarks (Best of NYC Cruise)
Get closer to the Statue of Liberty than most visitors
Circle the entire island of Manhattan
Cruise passes under 20 bridges including Brooklyn, Manhattan, and Williamsburg
Scenic 50-mile journey through the Hudson River Valley to Bear Mountain State Park
Oktoberfest themed cruises with German food and seasonal beers
Pup-friendly Halloween cruise supports North Shore Animal League America
Live DJ and open bar on New Year's Eve Party Cruise
Valid ID required for New Year's Eve Party Cruise (21+ event)
Special rates for groups of 15 or more, including school trips, corporate, birthdays, or family gatherings
includes: Expert live narration from a local NYC guide, available in 9 languages
Full bar and concessions onboard (food and drinks for purchase)
blurb: Circle Line Sightseeing Cruises has been New York City's most iconic boat tour since 1945. Cruise past the Statue of Liberty, Manhattan skyline, Brooklyn Bridge, and 150+ landmarks — with live narration, a full bar, and multilingual audio guides available. Departures from Pier 83 in Midtown and Pier 16 at South Street Seaport, 364 days a year.
